title: Learning to Construct Practical Agentic Systems
abstract: arXiv:2606.00189v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automated design and optimization of agentic LLM-based systems leads to sophisticated systems that substantially improve result quality over off-the-shelf agentic patterns. However, studies of fielded agentic systems show that production systems focus much more on issues such as simplicity, controllability, and predictability of inference costs. In this paper we propose principled approaches to designing and optimizing practical agentic systems. We describe an agent framework that enables designers to enforce modularity in agentic systems, by defining "pseudo-tools" that call LLMs recursively on a restricted context. Using this framework we hand-engineer agents for a diverse set of tasks, and show that relative to dynamically-planned workflows, hand-constructed fixed workflows are generally cheaper and more accurate. translated_title: 学习构建实用的智能体系统
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的智能体系统的自动化设计与优化能够构建出复杂的系统，相较于现成的智能体模式可显著提升结果质量。然而，对实际部署的智能体系统的研究表明，生产系统更加关注简洁性、可控性以及推理成本的可预测性等问题。在本文中，我们提出了设计与优化实用智能体系统的原则性方法。我们描述了一个智能体框架，通过定义在受限上下文上递归调用大语言模型的“伪工具”，使设计者能够在智能体系统中实现模块化。利用该框架，我们为多样化的任务手工构建了智能体，并表明与动态规划的工作流相比，手工构建的固定工作流通常成本更低且更准确。随后，我们针对该框架所需的智能体组件（即伪工具）提出了新颖的学习方法。
tldr: 提出了一种基于“伪工具”实现模块化的实用智能体系统设计框架，并证明手工构建的固定工作流比动态规划的工作流成本更低、准确性更高。
en_tdlr: Proposes a principled framework for building practical agentic systems with modular "pseudo-tools," demonstrating that hand-constructed fixed workflows are generally cheaper and more accurate than dynamically-planned workflows.
